name: sacred-observer-coordinated-run-leases
instr:
Sacred cannot keep competing workers from executing the same logical run. Add observer-coordinated leasing so execution requires authority from every participating observer. Acquire it before hooks, commands, or storage allocation, renew it with heartbeats, and release it on every terminal path. Ordinary `Experiment.run` behavior must remain unchanged.

`LeaseCapability` is a Enum. `LeaseState` is a Enum. `LeaseRequest`, `LeaseGrant`, `LeaseOutcome`, `LeaseConfigurationError`, `LeaseConflictError`, `LeaseLostError`, and `LeaseCoordinator` are public from `sacred.observers`. `LeaseCoordinator(observers)` provides `acquire(self, request)`, `renew(self, outcome, lifetime_seconds)`, and `release(self, outcome)`. It acquires capable observers by descending priority with stable ties, requires unanimous grants, and unwinds partial success in reverse order.

Run observers provide `acquire_lease(self, request)`, `renew_lease(self, grant, lifetime_seconds)`, and `release_lease(self, grant)`. Ownership is exclusive per logical run; renewal and release require matching owner and epoch. Nonpositive lifetimes raise `LeaseConfigurationError` before observer contact. It carries `field` and `value`; `LeaseConflictError` and `LeaseLostError` carry `outcome`.

FileStorageObserver, MongoObserver, SqlObserver, S3Observer, GoogleCloudStorageObserver, and TinyDB must preserve existing identity, allocation, initialization, overwrite, lifecycle records, and transactional guarantees while arbitrating
